links.evidence: The rule avoids repeated independent acceleration and deceleration around tiny segments and local stalls.
Offline expansion supplies the lift, remaining wait, and retract that allow UART cut handling to be nonblocking online.
gcode_planner parses into path_processing_core.types and calls export_npz to generate the system NPZ.
UI routes both adapters to export_npz, collecting parameters and offset consistency without duplicating export logic.
The core exporter centrally handles fiber cut among other events.
npz_exporter is described as responsible for segmentation, short-segment polyline merging, fitting, sampling, and final NPZ fields.
The GCode exporter path says short segments are sampled as original POLYLINE while normal long paths use B-splines.
GCode CLI cut_lift_mm and cut_wait_s correspond to the exporter lift distance and wait duration.
UI exposes cut_lift_mm and cut_wait_s but explicitly does not expand cut lift, wait, or retract itself.
GCode CUT maps to cut and is then expanded by the shared exporter into nonblocking cut event, lift, wait, and retract.
Formal UI sends GCode files through gcode_planner.gcode_parser before export.
